whatThisIs: The human arm of the T1 measured run, recovered from BSC testnet after the fact: the visitor's own dip transaction and their unaided protect() call, with block timestamps, so the time a person took to act is a chain fact rather than a claim. AGENT-ADVANTAGE-REPORT.md §1 recorded only the protect hash and the health factors.
howFound: From the protect transaction's sender, blocks were walked backwards until the same sender's previous transaction; it is MockPoolV2.dip(asset, 3500 bps) — the 35% dip the report describes. Selectors verified with web3_sha3 on a BNB Chain node.

labDelays.source: survivalguard/web/src/features/lab/dip-step.tsx ESCAPE_AFTER_S = 45; the lab hides the escape hatch for 30 s and offers it at 45 s after the dip, client-side

timing.note: Block timestamps have one-second resolution and ~0.75 s blocks. The 55 s includes the lab's own 45 s before the escape hatch is offered; the person's own reaction, from the hatch appearing to the protect transaction mined, is about 10 s. It does not include the seconds the visitor spent staging the dip.

limitations: One visitor, one run, on a demo position. This is a measurement of one person who was watching, not a baseline.
The visitor was a team member operating the public lab, not a stopwatched arm-B run under HUMAN-RUNS.md.
